scripts.install-all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('backend/public', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('backend/public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', { recursive: true });"
